basic_profile.bio: A passionate amateur chef from New York City, living the dream one pizza at a time. When I'm not experimenting with my Ooni Pro, you can find me tuning my GMC or diving deep into retro games like Secret of Mana. I'm a tech enthusiast with a soft spot for ham radios and wrestling matches. Usually online in the evenings after work, I work as a software developer and enjoy spending weekends with my partner exploring the city's food scene.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught culinary enthusiast with a knack for outdoor cooking and pizza making, honed through countless weekends of trial and error. Also well-versed in classic gaming systems and car maintenance, thanks to years of dedicated hobbyist pursuits.
